L1.en: Tonight, the old night train makes its last run.
L1.zh: 今夜，这列老夜车跑最后一趟。

L2b.en: all the way down to the sea.

L3b.en: it stopped at every small station on the line.
L3b.zh: 它在沿线每个小站都停。

L4.zh: 然后，是那条长长的隧道。

L5a.en: On the other side, the snow was gone,

L5b.en: and the river towns kept their lights on for it.
L5b.zh: 沿河的小镇都为它亮着灯。

L6.en: At the end of the line, the ocean was waiting.
L6.zh: 线路的尽头，大海在等它。

L7.en: One by one, the windows went dark.
L7.zh: 车窗一扇一扇暗了下去。

L8.en: But the station light stays on, for the next train.
L8.zh: 可站台的灯还亮着，等下一班车。
